name: Pyeongbeomhan Hoesa Iyagi
source:
A Story of a Company is a heart-warming visual novel about the everyday lives of animal/ human Hybrids at work. The story of the ordinary lives of extraordinary Hybrid characters is a journey of growth and self-reflection.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.astory.acompany.free.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
translation:
《动物公司》是一部温暖人心的视觉小说，讲述半人半兽的角色们在职场中的日常生活。这些不平凡的角色所度过的平凡日子，汇成一段成长与自我反思的旅程。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.astory.acompany.free.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]Google Play英文版[/url]]
